integrity.mathematical_evidence: Complete finite enumeration, verified acyclic Morse reductions, integral unimodular boundary eliminations, and combinatorial Alexander duality.
integrity.research_claim: New finite integral homology classification; no external independent certification is asserted.

limitations: Only the ordinary four-cut complexes of two fixed sixteen-vertex graphs are classified.
No complete homotopy type, cup-product ring, or all-parameter family theorem is asserted.
title: Integral four-cut homology separates the Shrikhande and rook graphs
